reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reasons that God inscribed the original Ten Words while Moses wrote out a copy of the covenant terms, letting both be credited as writers.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Richard Elliott Friedman catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Richard Elliott Friedman, The Bible with Sources Revealed: A New View into the Five Books of Moses (2003).

sides.snippet: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
sides.verseText: Yahweh said to Moses, \"Chisel two stone tablets like the first: and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

sides.snippet: He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
sides.verseText: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
